package main

import (
	"bytes"
	"context"
	"crypto/sha256"
	"encoding/hex"
	"encoding/json"
	"errors"
	"flag"
	"fmt"
	"io"
	"net"
	"net/http"
	"net/url"
	"os"
	"path/filepath"
	"strconv"
	"strings"
	"syscall"
	"time"

	"github.com/codetreker/remote-fs/packages/locking"
	"github.com/codetreker/remote-fs/packages/storage"
	"github.com/codetreker/remote-fs/packages/transport/httprest"
)

const (
	createPhase       = "readiness-create"
	reopenPhase       = "readiness-reopen"
	fixtureVolume     = "fixture-current"
	metadataNamespace = "fixture.current"
	maxStateBytes     = 16 << 10
	fixtureQuota      = 64 << 20
)

type options struct {
	Endpoint, Volume, RunID, SourceSHA, FixtureNonce, Phase, StateFile string
	Sequence                                                           uint64
}

type receipt struct {
	RunID          string `json:"run_id"`
	SourceSHA      string `json:"source_sha"`
	FixtureNonce   string `json:"fixture_nonce"`
	Phase          string `json:"phase"`
	Sequence       uint64 `json:"sequence"`
	Status         string `json:"status"`
	AuthorityEpoch string `json:"authority_epoch"`
	ObjectID       string `json:"object_id"`
}

type probeState struct {
	Version        int                    `json:"version"`
	RunID          string                 `json:"run_id"`
	SourceSHA      string                 `json:"source_sha"`
	FixtureNonce   string                 `json:"fixture_nonce"`
	Volume         string                 `json:"volume"`
	Phase          string                 `json:"phase"`
	Sequence       uint64                 `json:"sequence"`
	AuthorityEpoch string                 `json:"authority_epoch"`
	RootID         uint64                 `json:"root_id"`
	SentinelName   string                 `json:"sentinel_name"`
	Content        []byte                 `json:"content"`
	ContentSHA256  string                 `json:"content_sha256"`
	Reference      storage.ReferenceState `json:"reference"`
	LogicalUsed    int64                  `json:"logical_used"`
}

func main() {
	if err := command(os.Args[1:], os.Stdout); err != nil {
		fmt.Fprintln(os.Stderr, "current authority probe:", err)
		os.Exit(1)
	}
}

func command(args []string, stdout io.Writer) error {
	o, err := parseOptions(args)
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	ctx, cancel := context.WithTimeout(context.Background(), 24*time.Second)
	defer cancel()
	r, err := probe(ctx, o)
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	data, err := encodeReceipt(r)
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	n, err := stdout.Write(data)
	if err == nil && n != len(data) {
		err = io.ErrShortWrite
	}
	return err
}

func parseOptions(args []string) (options, error) {
	var o options
	flags := flag.NewFlagSet("current-authority-probe", flag.ContinueOnError)
	flags.SetOutput(io.Discard)
	flags.StringVar(&o.Endpoint, "endpoint", "", "loopback HTTP endpoint")
	flags.StringVar(&o.Volume, "volume", "", "fixture volume")
	flags.StringVar(&o.RunID, "run-id", "", "run identity")
	flags.StringVar(&o.SourceSHA, "source-sha", "", "source commit")
	flags.StringVar(&o.FixtureNonce, "fixture-nonce", "", "fixture nonce")
	flags.StringVar(&o.Phase, "phase", "", "readiness phase")
	flags.StringVar(&o.StateFile, "state-file", "", "private probe state")
	flags.Uint64Var(&o.Sequence, "sequence", 0, "probe sequence")
	if err := flags.Parse(args); err != nil {
		return o, err
	}
	if flags.NArg() != 0 {
		return o, errors.New("positional arguments are not accepted")
	}
	if err := o.check(); err != nil {
		return o, err
	}
	return o, nil
}

func (o options) check() error {
	u, err := url.Parse(o.Endpoint)
	if err != nil || u.Scheme != "http" || u.Hostname() != "127.0.0.1" || u.User != nil || u.Path != "" || u.RawQuery != "" || u.ForceQuery || u.Fragment != "" {
		return errors.New("endpoint must be http://127.0.0.1:PORT")
	}
	port, err := strconv.ParseUint(u.Port(), 10, 16)
	if err != nil || port == 0 || u.Host != net.JoinHostPort("127.0.0.1", strconv.FormatUint(port, 10)) {
		return errors.New("endpoint requires a canonical nonzero TCP port")
	}
	if o.Volume != fixtureVolume {
		return errors.New("volume must be fixture-current")
	}
	if !identifier(o.RunID, 64) || !lowerHex(o.SourceSHA, 40) || !lowerHex(o.FixtureNonce, 64) {
		return errors.New("run-id, source-sha or fixture-nonce is invalid")
	}
	if o.Phase != createPhase && o.Phase != reopenPhase {
		return errors.New("invalid readiness phase")
	}
	if o.Sequence == 0 || o.Sequence == ^uint64(0) {
		return errors.New("sequence is outside the supported range")
	}
	if filepath.Base(o.StateFile) != "probe-state.json" || filepath.Base(filepath.Dir(o.StateFile)) != "evidence" {
		return errors.New("state-file must be RUN/evidence/probe-state.json")
	}
	return nil
}

func identifier(value string, limit int) bool {
	if len(value) == 0 || len(value) > limit {
		return false
	}
	for _, c := range value {
		if !(c >= 'a' && c <= 'z' || c >= 'A' && c <= 'Z' || c >= '0' && c <= '9' || c == '-' || c == '_') {
			return false
		}
	}
	return true
}

func lowerHex(value string, size int) bool {
	if len(value) != size {
		return false
	}
	for _, c := range value {
		if !(c >= '0' && c <= '9' || c >= 'a' && c <= 'f') {
			return false
		}
	}
	return true
}

func encodeReceipt(r receipt) ([]byte, error) {
	if r.Status != "ok" || r.AuthorityEpoch == "" || len(r.AuthorityEpoch) > 128 || r.ObjectID == "" {
		return nil, errors.New("incomplete readiness receipt")
	}
	data, err := json.Marshal(r)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	data = append(data, '\n')
	if len(data) > 1024 {
		return nil, errors.New("readiness receipt exceeds 1 KiB")
	}
	return data, nil
}

type ownedClose struct {
	name      string
	close     func(context.Context) error
	attempted bool
	result    error
}

func (c *ownedClose) release(ctx context.Context) error {
	if c.attempted {
		return c.result
	}
	c.attempted = true
	if err := c.close(ctx); err != nil {
		c.result = fmt.Errorf("close %s: %w", c.name, err)
	}
	return c.result
}

type ownership struct{ entries []*ownedClose }

func (o *ownership) add(name string, close func(context.Context) error) *ownedClose {
	c := &ownedClose{name: name, close: close}
	o.entries = append(o.entries, c)
	return c
}

func (o *ownership) release(ctx context.Context) error {
	var result error
	for i := len(o.entries) - 1; i >= 0; i-- {
		result = errors.Join(result, o.entries[i].release(ctx))
	}
	return result
}

type fixtureSession interface {
	storage.FileSession
	storage.AtomicFileOpener
	storage.NodeReferences
	storage.NamespaceAccess
}

type fixture struct {
	client  *httprest.Storage
	session fixtureSession
	owned   *ownership
	root    storage.DirectoryTarget
	options options
	epoch   string
}

func probe(ctx context.Context, o options) (answer receipt, returned error) {
	if err := checkStateDirectory(o.StateFile); err != nil {
		return answer, err
	}
	var saved probeState
	if o.Phase == reopenPhase {
		var err error
		saved, err = readState(o)
		if err != nil {
			return answer, err
		}
	} else if _, err := os.Lstat(o.StateFile); !errors.Is(err, os.ErrNotExist) {
		if err != nil {
			return answer, err
		}
		return answer, errors.New("create requires an absent probe state file")
	}
	transport := http.DefaultTransport.(*http.Transport).Clone()
	transport.Proxy = nil
	transport.DialContext = (&net.Dialer{Timeout: 4 * time.Second}).DialContext
	transport.MaxConnsPerHost = 1
	defer transport.CloseIdleConnections()
	httpClient := &http.Client{Transport: transport, Timeout: 4 * time.Second, CheckRedirect: func(*http.Request, []*http.Request) error { return errors.New("HTTP redirects are forbidden") }}
	dialOptions := httprest.DefaultDialOptions()
	dialOptions.MaxBodyBytes = 64 << 10
	dialOptions.MaxWriteBytes = 4 << 10
	client, err := httprest.DialWithOptions(o.Endpoint, httpClient, dialOptions)
	if err != nil {
		return answer, err
	}
	status, err := waitAuthority(ctx, client)
	if err != nil {
		return answer, err
	}
	if status.Authority == "" || len(status.Authority) > 128 || status.Unavailable || status.Recovering {
		return answer, errors.New("authority is unavailable, recovering or has no valid identity")
	}
	if o.Phase == reopenPhase && status.Authority == saved.AuthorityEpoch {
		return answer, errors.New("reopen reached the original authority instance")
	}
	var owned ownership
	defer func() {
		cleanup, cancel := context.WithTimeout(context.Background(), 5*time.Second)
		defer cancel()
		returned = errors.Join(returned, owned.release(cleanup))
	}()
	ticket, err := client.BeginEnrollment(ctx)
	if err != nil {
		return answer, fmt.Errorf("begin authority enrollment: %w", err)
	}
	lockSession, err := client.OpenSession(ctx, ticket)
	if lockSession.ID != "" {
		owned.add("authority session", func(ctx context.Context) error { return client.CloseSession(ctx, lockSession.ID) })
	}
	if err != nil {
		return answer, fmt.Errorf("enroll authority session: %w", err)
	}
	if lockSession.ID == "" || lockSession.Authority != status.Authority || lockSession.Retired || lockSession.HistoryExpiresMillis <= lockSession.NowMillis {
		return answer, errors.New("authority enrollment returned an invalid live session")
	}
	sessionOptions := storage.DefaultFileSessionOptions()
	sessionOptions.MaxFileSize = 4 << 10
	sessionOptions.MaxFiles = 4
	sessionOptions.MaxOperations = 1
	sessionOptions.MaxWaiters = 0
	opened, err := client.NewFileSession(ctx, sessionOptions)
	if opened != nil {
		owned.add("file session", opened.Close)
	}
	if err != nil {
		return answer, fmt.Errorf("enroll file session: %w", err)
	}
	session, ok := opened.(fixtureSession)
	if !ok {
		return answer, errors.New("file session lacks required capabilities")
	}
	for _, check := range []func() error{session.CheckAtomicFileOpen, session.CheckNamespaceAccess, session.CheckNodeReferences} {
		if err := check(); err != nil {
			return answer, fmt.Errorf("file capability: %w", err)
		}
	}
	live, err := session.Status(ctx)
	if err != nil {
		return answer, fmt.Errorf("file session status: %w", err)
	}
	if live.Epoch == "" || live.Remaining <= 0 || live.HistoryRemaining <= 0 || live.Revision == 0 || live.ActionEpoch == 0 || live.Retired || live.Fenced {
		return answer, errors.New("file session is not live")
	}
	root, err := client.Stat(ctx, "")
	if err != nil {
		return answer, fmt.Errorf("stat root: %w", err)
	}
	if root.ID == 0 || root.Kind != storage.NodeDirectory {
		return answer, errors.New("root has no directory identity")
	}
	if o.Phase == reopenPhase && root.ID != saved.RootID {
		return answer, errors.New("reopen changed root identity")
	}
	rootResult, err := session.OpenNodeRef(ctx, root.ID, storage.NodeRefOptions{
		Kind: storage.NodeDirectory, Target: storage.ChildCondition{State: storage.SameNode, NodeID: root.ID},
		Use: storage.UseClaim{Uses: storage.ReadEntries}, MetadataAccess: storage.ReadMetadata,
	})
	if rootResult.Reference != nil {
		owned.add("root reference", rootResult.Reference.Close)
	}
	if err != nil {
		return answer, fmt.Errorf("retain root: %w", err)
	}
	if rootResult.Reference == nil || rootResult.Attr.ID != root.ID || rootResult.Attr.Kind != storage.NodeDirectory || rootResult.Outcome != storage.Opened {
		return answer, errors.New("retained root differs from the observed root")
	}
	rootScope, err := scopeOf(ctx, rootResult.Reference)
	if err != nil {
		return answer, err
	}
	f := fixture{client: client, session: session, owned: &owned, root: storage.DirectoryTarget{NodeID: root.ID, Scope: &rootScope}, options: o, epoch: lockSession.Authority}
	if o.Phase == createPhase {
		saved, err = f.create(ctx)
	} else {
		err = f.reopen(ctx, saved)
	}
	if err != nil {
		return answer, err
	}
	cleanup, cancel := context.WithTimeout(context.Background(), 5*time.Second)
	err = owned.release(cleanup)
	cancel()
	if err != nil {
		return answer, err
	}
	if o.Phase == createPhase {
		if err := writeState(o.StateFile, saved); err != nil {
			return answer, err
		}
	}
	return receipt{RunID: o.RunID, SourceSHA: o.SourceSHA, FixtureNonce: o.FixtureNonce, Phase: o.Phase, Sequence: o.Sequence,
		Status: "ok", AuthorityEpoch: lockSession.Authority, ObjectID: strconv.FormatUint(saved.Reference.Attr.ID, 10)}, nil
}

func waitAuthority(ctx context.Context, client *httprest.Storage) (locking.Status, error) {
	for {
		status, err := client.Status(ctx)
		if err == nil {
			return status, nil
		}
		select {
		case <-ctx.Done():
			return locking.Status{}, fmt.Errorf("authority readiness: %w", errors.Join(ctx.Err(), err))
		case <-time.After(100 * time.Millisecond):
		}
	}
}

func scopeOf(ctx context.Context, reference storage.NodeReference) (storage.UseScope, error) {
	scoped, ok := reference.(storage.ScopedReference)
	if !ok {
		return storage.UseScope{}, errors.New("reference lacks scope capability")
	}
	if err := scoped.CheckScopedReference(); err != nil {
		return storage.UseScope{}, err
	}
	scope, err := scoped.Scope(ctx)
	if err != nil {
		return storage.UseScope{}, err
	}
	if scope.Token == "" {
		return storage.UseScope{}, errors.New("reference has an empty scope")
	}
	return scope, nil
}

func (f *fixture) child(name string) storage.ChildName {
	return storage.ChildName{Parent: f.root, RawLeaf: []byte(name)}
}

func (f *fixture) directory(ctx context.Context, expectedName string, expectedID uint64) error {
	listing, err := f.session.ReadDirNode(ctx, f.root)
	if err != nil {
		return fmt.Errorf("read root directory: %w", err)
	}
	if listing.Observation.ParentID != f.root.NodeID || len(listing.Observation.Revision) == 0 {
		return errors.New("root listing has no valid observation")
	}
	if expectedName == "" {
		if len(listing.Entries) != 0 {
			return errors.New("fixture root is not empty")
		}
	} else if len(listing.Entries) != 1 || string(listing.Entries[0].RawLeaf) != expectedName || listing.Entries[0].Attr.ID != expectedID {
		return errors.New("fixture root does not contain exactly the retained sentinel")
	}
	return nil
}

func (f *fixture) quota(ctx context.Context, expected int64) error {
	space, err := f.client.Space(ctx)
	if err != nil {
		return fmt.Errorf("logical quota: %w", err)
	}
	if !space.Coherent() || space.Total != fixtureQuota || space.Used != expected {
		return fmt.Errorf("logical quota differs: total=%d used=%d expected=%d", space.Total, space.Used, expected)
	}
	return nil
}

func (f *fixture) open(ctx context.Context, name string, expected uint64, metadata map[string][]byte) (storage.File, *ownedClose, error) {
	o := storage.OpenAtOptions{Read: true, Existing: storage.Keep, Use: storage.UseClaim{Uses: storage.ReadData | storage.DeleteName}}
	if expected == 0 {
		o.Write, o.Create, o.Exclusive = true, true, true
		o.Use.Uses |= storage.WriteData
		o.Target = storage.ChildCondition{State: storage.Absent}
	} else {
		o.Target = storage.ChildCondition{State: storage.SameNode, NodeID: expected}
		o.ExpectedMetadata = metadata
	}
	result, err := f.session.OpenAt(ctx, f.child(name), o)
	var owned *ownedClose
	if result.File != nil {
		owned = f.owned.add("file reference", result.File.Close)
	}
	if err != nil {
		return nil, owned, fmt.Errorf("open %s: %w", name, err)
	}
	want := storage.Created
	if expected != 0 {
		want = storage.Opened
	}
	if result.File == nil || result.Attr.ID == 0 || result.Attr.Kind != storage.NodeRegular || result.Outcome != want || expected != 0 && result.Attr.ID != expected {
		return nil, owned, errors.New("open returned a different object or outcome")
	}
	return result.File, owned, nil
}

func (f *fixture) create(ctx context.Context) (probeState, error) {
	var state probeState
	if err := f.directory(ctx, "", 0); err != nil {
		return state, err
	}
	if err := f.quota(ctx, 0); err != nil {
		return state, err
	}
	name := "probe-" + f.options.FixtureNonce
	file, owned, err := f.open(ctx, name, 0, nil)
	if err != nil {
		return state, err
	}
	content := fixtureContent(f.options, "smoke")
	before, err := initializeFile(ctx, file, content)
	if err != nil {
		return state, err
	}
	if err := f.quota(ctx, int64(len(content))); err != nil {
		return state, err
	}
	scope, err := scopeOf(ctx, file)
	if err != nil {
		return state, err
	}
	renamed := name + "-renamed"
	result, err := f.session.MutateName(ctx, storage.NameCommand{
		Kind: storage.NameRename, Name: f.child(name), Target: storage.ChildCondition{State: storage.SameNode, NodeID: before.Attr.ID},
		Destination: &storage.RenameTarget{Parent: f.root, ObservedLeaf: []byte(renamed), Expected: storage.ChildCondition{State: storage.Absent}, OutputLeaf: []byte(renamed)},
		Uses:        []storage.TargetUse{{NodeID: before.Attr.ID, Scope: scope}},
	})
	if err != nil {
		return state, fmt.Errorf("rename retained file: %w", err)
	}
	if result.Attr == nil || result.Attr.ID != before.Attr.ID {
		return state, errors.New("rename changed object identity")
	}
	if err := f.absent(ctx, name); err != nil {
		return state, err
	}
	if err := f.directory(ctx, renamed, before.Attr.ID); err != nil {
		return state, err
	}
	if err := verifyFile(ctx, file, before, content, false); err != nil {
		return state, err
	}
	if err := f.remove(ctx, renamed, before.Attr.ID, scope); err != nil {
		return state, err
	}
	if err := verifyFile(ctx, file, before, content, true); err != nil {
		return state, err
	}
	if err := f.quota(ctx, int64(len(content))); err != nil {
		return state, err
	}
	if err := owned.release(ctx); err != nil {
		return state, err
	}
	if err := f.quota(ctx, 0); err != nil {
		return state, err
	}
	if err := f.directory(ctx, "", 0); err != nil {
		return state, err
	}
	sentinel := "sentinel-" + f.options.FixtureNonce
	file, owned, err = f.open(ctx, sentinel, 0, nil)
	if err != nil {
		return state, err
	}
	content = fixtureContent(f.options, "sentinel")
	reference, err := initializeFile(ctx, file, content)
	if err != nil {
		return state, err
	}
	if err := file.Sync(ctx); err != nil {
		return state, fmt.Errorf("sync sentinel: %w", err)
	}
	if err := owned.release(ctx); err != nil {
		return state, err
	}
	if err := f.quota(ctx, int64(len(content))); err != nil {
		return state, err
	}
	if err := f.directory(ctx, sentinel, reference.Attr.ID); err != nil {
		return state, err
	}
	return probeState{Version: 1, RunID: f.options.RunID, SourceSHA: f.options.SourceSHA, FixtureNonce: f.options.FixtureNonce,
		Volume: f.options.Volume, Phase: createPhase, Sequence: f.options.Sequence, AuthorityEpoch: f.epoch, RootID: f.root.NodeID,
		SentinelName: sentinel, Content: content, ContentSHA256: digest(content), Reference: reference, LogicalUsed: int64(len(content))}, nil
}

func (f *fixture) reopen(ctx context.Context, state probeState) error {
	if err := f.directory(ctx, state.SentinelName, state.Reference.Attr.ID); err != nil {
		return err
	}
	if err := f.quota(ctx, state.LogicalUsed); err != nil {
		return err
	}
	versions := map[string][]byte{metadataNamespace: state.Reference.Attr.Metadata[metadataNamespace].Version}
	file, owned, err := f.open(ctx, state.SentinelName, state.Reference.Attr.ID, versions)
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	if err := verifyFile(ctx, file, state.Reference, state.Content, false); err != nil {
		return err
	}
	scope, err := scopeOf(ctx, file)
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	if err := f.remove(ctx, state.SentinelName, state.Reference.Attr.ID, scope); err != nil {
		return err
	}
	if err := verifyFile(ctx, file, state.Reference, state.Content, true); err != nil {
		return err
	}
	if err := f.quota(ctx, state.LogicalUsed); err != nil {
		return err
	}
	if err := owned.release(ctx); err != nil {
		return err
	}
	if err := f.quota(ctx, 0); err != nil {
		return err
	}
	return f.directory(ctx, "", 0)
}

func (f *fixture) absent(ctx context.Context, name string) error {
	_, err := f.session.LookupAt(ctx, f.child(name))
	if !errors.Is(err, syscall.ENOENT) || storage.ErrnoOf(err) != syscall.ENOENT {
		return fmt.Errorf("removed name remains observable or unknown: %w", errors.Join(errors.New("expected ENOENT"), err))
	}
	return nil
}

func (f *fixture) remove(ctx context.Context, name string, id uint64, scope storage.UseScope) error {
	result, err := f.session.MutateName(ctx, storage.NameCommand{Kind: storage.NameRemove, Name: f.child(name),
		Target: storage.ChildCondition{State: storage.SameNode, NodeID: id}, Uses: []storage.TargetUse{{NodeID: id, Scope: scope}}})
	if err != nil {
		return fmt.Errorf("unlink retained file: %w", err)
	}
	if result.Attr != nil && result.Attr.ID != id {
		return errors.New("unlink returned a different identity")
	}
	return f.absent(ctx, name)
}

func initializeFile(ctx context.Context, file storage.File, content []byte) (storage.ReferenceState, error) {
	var empty storage.ReferenceState
	attr, err := file.WriteAt(ctx, 0, content)
	if err != nil {
		return empty, fmt.Errorf("write file: %w", err)
	}
	if attr.ID == 0 || attr.Size != int64(len(content)) || attr.Kind != storage.NodeRegular {
		return empty, errors.New("write returned invalid attributes")
	}
	metadata, ok := file.(storage.ReferenceMetadataAccess)
	if !ok {
		return empty, errors.New("file lacks metadata CAS")
	}
	if err := metadata.CheckMetadataAccess(); err != nil {
		return empty, err
	}
	first, err := metadata.SetMetadata(ctx, metadataNamespace, nil, []byte("created:"+digest(content)))
	if err != nil {
		return empty, fmt.Errorf("initial metadata CAS: %w", err)
	}
	if len(first.Version) == 0 || !bytes.Equal(first.Data, []byte("created:"+digest(content))) {
		return empty, errors.New("initial metadata CAS returned an invalid payload")
	}
	finalData := []byte("sealed:" + digest(content))
	current, err := metadata.SetMetadata(ctx, metadataNamespace, first.Version, finalData)
	if err != nil {
		return empty, fmt.Errorf("replace metadata CAS: %w", err)
	}
	if len(current.Version) == 0 || bytes.Equal(current.Version, first.Version) || !bytes.Equal(current.Data, finalData) {
		return empty, errors.New("metadata CAS did not advance its token and value")
	}
	_, err = metadata.SetMetadata(ctx, metadataNamespace, first.Version, []byte("stale"))
	if !errors.Is(err, storage.ErrConditionConflict) {
		return empty, fmt.Errorf("stale metadata CAS was not rejected: %w", errors.Join(errors.New("expected condition conflict"), err))
	}
	state, err := fileState(ctx, file)
	if err != nil {
		return empty, err
	}
	attr.Metadata = map[string]storage.OpaquePayload{metadataNamespace: current}
	if err := sameAttr(state.Attr, attr); err != nil {
		return empty, err
	}
	if err := verifyFile(ctx, file, state, content, false); err != nil {
		return empty, err
	}
	return state, nil
}

func fileState(ctx context.Context, file storage.File) (storage.ReferenceState, error) {
	state, ok := file.(storage.ReferenceStateAccess)
	if !ok {
		return storage.ReferenceState{}, errors.New("file lacks reference state")
	}
	if err := state.CheckReferenceState(); err != nil {
		return storage.ReferenceState{}, err
	}
	return state.State(ctx)
}

func sameAttr(got, want storage.Attr) error {
	if got.ID != want.ID || got.Kind != storage.NodeRegular || got.Kind != want.Kind || got.Size != want.Size {
		return errors.New("file identity, kind or logical size changed")
	}
	if err := storage.CheckMetadata(got.Metadata); err != nil {
		return fmt.Errorf("invalid file metadata: %w", err)
	}
	if len(got.Metadata) != len(want.Metadata) {
		return errors.New("file metadata namespace set changed")
	}
	for key, expected := range want.Metadata {
		value, ok := got.Metadata[key]
		if !ok || !bytes.Equal(value.Version, expected.Version) || !bytes.Equal(value.Data, expected.Data) {
			return errors.New("file metadata token or payload changed")
		}
	}
	return nil
}

func verifyFile(ctx context.Context, file storage.File, expected storage.ReferenceState, content []byte, detached bool) error {
	state, err := fileState(ctx, file)
	if err != nil {
		return fmt.Errorf("read reference state: %w", err)
	}
	if err := sameAttr(state.Attr, expected.Attr); err != nil {
		return err
	}
	if state.Detached != detached || state.PendingUnlink || len(state.PendingGeneration) != 0 || len(state.LinkTarget) != 0 {
		return errors.New("unexpected retained reference state")
	}
	var data []byte
	for len(data) < len(content) {
		read, err := file.ReadAt(ctx, int64(len(data)), len(content)-len(data))
		if err != nil {
			return fmt.Errorf("read retained bytes: %w", err)
		}
		if err := sameAttr(read.Attr, expected.Attr); err != nil {
			return err
		}
		if len(read.Data) == 0 || len(read.Data) > len(content)-len(data) {
			return errors.New("read made no progress or exceeded its request")
		}
		data = append(data, read.Data...)
	}
	if !bytes.Equal(data, content) || digest(data) != digest(content) {
		return errors.New("retained content differs from the fixture payload")
	}
	eof, err := file.ReadAt(ctx, int64(len(content)), 1)
	if err != nil {
		return fmt.Errorf("read EOF: %w", err)
	}
	if len(eof.Data) != 0 {
		return errors.New("read returned bytes beyond sentinel EOF")
	}
	return sameAttr(eof.Attr, expected.Attr)
}

func fixtureContent(o options, kind string) []byte {
	return []byte(strings.Join([]string{"remote-fs-current-authority", kind, o.RunID, o.SourceSHA, o.FixtureNonce, o.Volume, ""}, "\n"))
}

func digest(data []byte) string { sum := sha256.Sum256(data); return hex.EncodeToString(sum[:]) }

func checkStateDirectory(path string) error {
	for _, directory := range []string{filepath.Dir(path), filepath.Dir(filepath.Dir(path))} {
		if err := validatePrivateDirectory(directory); err != nil {
			return fmt.Errorf("state directory: %w", err)
		}
	}
	return nil
}

func writeState(path string, state probeState) error {
	if err := checkStateDirectory(path); err != nil {
		return err
	}
	data, err := json.Marshal(state)
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	data = append(data, '\n')
	if len(data) > maxStateBytes {
		return errors.New("probe state exceeds 16 KiB")
	}
	file, err := os.OpenFile(path, os.O_WRONLY|os.O_CREATE|os.O_EXCL, 0600)
	if err != nil {
		return fmt.Errorf("create probe state: %w", err)
	}
	if err := makePrivateFile(path); err != nil {
		return errors.Join(fmt.Errorf("protect probe state: %w", err), file.Close())
	}
	n, writeErr := file.Write(data)
	if writeErr == nil && n != len(data) {
		writeErr = io.ErrShortWrite
	}
	var syncErr error
	if writeErr == nil {
		syncErr = file.Sync()
	}
	return errors.Join(writeErr, syncErr, file.Close())
}

func readState(o options) (probeState, error) {
	var state probeState
	if err := checkStateDirectory(o.StateFile); err != nil {
		return state, err
	}
	if err := validatePrivateFile(o.StateFile); err != nil {
		return state, fmt.Errorf("probe state privacy: %w", err)
	}
	before, err := os.Lstat(o.StateFile)
	if err != nil {
		return state, fmt.Errorf("probe state: %w", err)
	}
	if !before.Mode().IsRegular() || before.Size() <= 0 || before.Size() > maxStateBytes {
		return state, errors.New("probe state must be a private regular file of at most 16 KiB")
	}
	file, err := os.Open(o.StateFile)
	if err != nil {
		return state, err
	}
	opened, statErr := file.Stat()
	if statErr != nil || !os.SameFile(before, opened) {
		return state, errors.Join(errors.New("probe state identity changed while opening"), statErr, file.Close())
	}
	data, readErr := io.ReadAll(io.LimitReader(file, maxStateBytes+1))
	if err := errors.Join(readErr, file.Close()); err != nil {
		return state, err
	}
	if len(data) > maxStateBytes {
		return state, errors.New("probe state exceeds 16 KiB")
	}
	if err := json.Unmarshal(data, &state); err != nil {
		return state, fmt.Errorf("decode probe state: %w", err)
	}
	canonical, err := json.Marshal(state)
	if err != nil {
		return state, err
	}
	if !bytes.Equal(data, append(canonical, '\n')) {
		return state, errors.New("probe state is not canonical or contains unknown fields")
	}
	if err := state.check(o); err != nil {
		return state, err
	}
	return state, nil
}

func (s probeState) check(o options) error {
	if s.Version != 1 || s.Phase != createPhase || s.Sequence == 0 || s.Sequence == ^uint64(0) || o.Sequence != s.Sequence+1 ||
		s.RunID != o.RunID || s.SourceSHA != o.SourceSHA || s.FixtureNonce != o.FixtureNonce || s.Volume != o.Volume {
		return errors.New("probe state run, source, nonce, volume or sequence differs")
	}
	if !identifier(s.AuthorityEpoch, 128) || s.RootID == 0 || s.Reference.Attr.ID == 0 || s.RootID == s.Reference.Attr.ID ||
		s.SentinelName != "sentinel-"+o.FixtureNonce || !bytes.Equal(s.Content, fixtureContent(o, "sentinel")) ||
		s.ContentSHA256 != digest(s.Content) || s.LogicalUsed != int64(len(s.Content)) || s.Reference.Attr.Size != s.LogicalUsed ||
		s.Reference.Attr.Kind != storage.NodeRegular || s.Reference.Detached || s.Reference.PendingUnlink || len(s.Reference.PendingGeneration) != 0 || len(s.Reference.LinkTarget) != 0 {
		return errors.New("probe state contains an invalid sentinel")
	}
	if err := storage.CheckMetadata(s.Reference.Attr.Metadata); err != nil {
		return fmt.Errorf("probe state metadata: %w", err)
	}
	metadata, ok := s.Reference.Attr.Metadata[metadataNamespace]
	if !ok || len(s.Reference.Attr.Metadata) != 1 || !bytes.Equal(metadata.Data, []byte("sealed:"+s.ContentSHA256)) {
		return errors.New("probe state metadata does not match its sentinel")
	}
	return nil
}
